items.title: Snowflake (SNOW) Brings AI Native Security To Its Marketplace
items.summary: Snowflake (NYSE:SNOW) announced a new alliance with CrowdStrike to deliver AI native security capabilities through Snowflake Marketplace. The partnership integrates CrowdStrike Falcon data and security operations directly into Snowflake's data platform for enterprise customers. Customers are expected to use existing Snowflake commitments more flexibly as they adopt these AI driven security tools within the same environment.
